mapper.select: SELECT json_build_object( 'project',row_to_json(p), 'steps',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(r) ORDER BY r.step_sn) FROM tb_pj_step r WHERE r.proj_id=p.proj_id),'[]'::json), 'parts',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(r) ORDER BY r.aply_bgn_ym) FROM tb_pj_proj_part r WHERE r.proj_id=p.proj_id),'[]'::json), 'plans',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(r) ORDER BY r.job_cd) FROM tb_pj_mnpw_plan r WHERE r.proj_id=p.proj_id),'[]'::json), 'expenses',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(r) ORDER BY r.exps_ym,r.exps_sn) FROM tb_pj_drct_exps r WHERE r.proj_id=p.proj_id),'[]'::json), 'distribution',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(r) ORDER BY r.dstrb_step_cd,r.row_sn,r.dstrb_ym) FROM tb_pj_tk_dstrb r WHERE r.proj_id=p.proj_id),'[]'::json), 'pm',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(r) ORDER BY r.user_id,r.scope_sn) FROM tb_sy_user_scope r WHERE r.proj_id=p.proj_id AND r.scope_type_cd='PROJ'),'[]'::json) )::text FROM tb_pj_proj p WHERE p.proj_id=#{id}
SELECT std_val FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd=#{key} AND aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(max(hist_sn),0) FROM tb_pj_proj_chg WHERE proj_id=#{id}
